brief: Describes one of the five secrets a live payment needs, by name and kind, as a token that can expire.
detail: The five parts are the OAuth client, the API key, the mTLS private key, its certificate and a webhook secret. A descriptor is a stzToken underneath, because a token is the one kind of secret the store already knows how to expire, and its kind says which part it is. It carries no value until a source is given: the value comes from an environment variable, a file outside the repository or a vault, and is shown by no output. Use invented values in a test and never write a real one in a source file, a memo or an example. A descriptor that is only a name is refused by the registry in production, as is one whose certificate has lapsed.
